title: Cuckoo Filter
description: Cuckoo Filter documents a probabilistic membership data structure in the knowledge domain. It explains when to use a compact approximate set, how lookup and deletion semantics differ from an exact map, why sparse checkpoints can reduce the need for approximate indexing, and how to decide between a Cuckoo filter and a map. Important search terms include probabilistic data structure, approximate membership, false positive, Bloom filter, hash table, checkpoint interval, and map.
